blocks.text: Era Zero now has 90 canonical roots and 234 provisional roots in 26 nine-root chunks. No completed review packet awaits a decision. The broad English translator remains blocked. A restricted explicit-ID renderer may cover only the 90 canonical roots and must reject provisional meanings, unapproved compounds, and underspecified grammar.
The next semantic block is MIN:100–122. It was not begun here. Gate 4, the compound architecture, and translator implementation were not begun.
